description: A reading check-in with no request for analysis. Muse should respond to the reader's experience of pausing, not retell or interpret the chapter.

input.reader_message: Read the first chapter on the train home and had to stop once she fell down the rabbit-hole. I just stared out the window for a while.

criteria: responds to the reader's experience of stopping and staring out the window
does not retell or interpret events from the chapter
asks at most one light question
forbidden_claims: an interpretation of what the fall means in the book
